app.name: trace

home.review.one: 1 form is waiting for your review.
home.review.other: {n} forms are waiting for your review.

home.sent: Everything is on its way to signature.
home.card0: Photograph a form or open a template. What you say lands in the fields; what stays unclear you see before sending.

home.card.one: 1 form captured today: {e} empty, {f} filled, {s} sent for signature.
home.card.other: {n} forms captured today: {e} empty, {f} filled, {s} sent for signature.

home.card.review: Review the entries before you send.
home.card.dictate: Open a form and dictate the details.
todo.empty: The next steps for your forms appear here.
hist.empty: What happens today shows up here.
cam.title: Photograph form
cam.hint: Place the form in the frame, then release the shutter.
cam.file: The camera cannot open here directly. The shutter opens the device camera or the photo picker.
cam.taken: Photo taken. It stays on the device.
rec.title: Recognizing form …
rec.wait: Just a moment. Recognition is mocked.
verify.card: Recognized as {f} by {i}, {n} labels with a field. Untick a field that is not on the form like this.
verify.pv: The fields sit where they are on the page. Tap one for its name; unticked fields are dashed.
forms.empty: Nothing captured yet. Photograph a form or pick a template.
form.then: Confirm or complete them – you can send as it is, too.
form.done: All entries are confirmed. You can send the form for signature.
form.empty: Tap “Start listening” and say the details for the {f} in your own words. The fields fill in afterwards.
form.pv.filled: This is how it stands in the form. Green is confirmed, yellow unclear, red missing. Tap a field for its value.
form.pv.empty: The fields as they lie on the page. After listening, the values appear in them.
rec.fail: The microphone cannot open here. Type the answer instead.
sign.title: Send for signature
sign.card: The completed PDF goes to the recipient. They sign on their device; you get the signed document back. The signature service is mocked.
subject: Subject
mail.body: Attached is the {f} of {d} for signature. Please check it and sign on your device.
sent.empty: Nothing on its way. Sent forms wait here until the recipient has signed.
sheet.open2: Dictate a saved form or a template
pv.meta: Page 1 of {n} · positions from the page · pinch to zoom
cam.flat: No sheet edge found; taking the picture as it is.
cam.onlyimages: Images only: this file cannot be opened as an image.
rec.transcribing: Transcribing … the pieces appear here as they come back.
v.notliteral: Not word for word in the dictation.
rec.filling: Filling the fields from the dictation …
hint.format.date: That is not a readable date.
sign.norecipient: no recipient on this form yet
form.ask: Answer the questions for the {f} one by one, typed or spoken – or tap “Start listening” and say everything at once; the order doesn’t matter then.
chat.choose: Tap an option, or say it.
chat.table: Say the entries; you can correct them afterwards.
chat.unheard: I heard nothing. Try again, or type the answer.
tr.hint.demo: Tap to see the wording. Transcript and mapping are made up.
tr.title: Translating the form …
tr.wait: This happens once per form and language.
trv.title: Translating your answers …
trv.m1: Into the language of the form
trv.m2: Numbers and names are held against what you said
form.translate: Tap “Continue”: your answers are translated into the language of the form, and you check them once more.
form.goon: Answer the next one, say the rest at once – or tap “Continue”: what is open stays empty.

sign.missing.one: 1 required entry is still missing. You can send anyway.
sign.missing.other: {n} required entries are still missing. You can send anyway.

job.catalogue: Collecting what is asked of the fields …
edit.name: Name of the form
edit.card: {n} fields found. Tap a field and change its label, kind, question or whether it is required. On the page you move it; with a mouse you drag its corner to size it. No tick means: not a field.

edit.doubts.one: Please look at 1 field, it is marked red.
edit.doubts.other: Please look at {n} fields, they are marked red.

edit.label: Label
edit.question: Question in the conversation
edit.place: Tap the place on the page where the new field goes.
edit.pv: Tap a field and move it; with a mouse drag its corner to size it. Two fingers or the mouse wheel zoom the page.
edit.s1: Putting fields and questions together anew
edit.wait: The model writes only what changed.
v.chosen: Picked from the list; it is not in the dictation word for word.
edit.values.hint: one value per line; empty: the field takes any text
edit.kind.proposed: Proposed by the model. Choose another kind if it is not right.
hint.format.time: That is not a readable time.
hint.format.phone: That is not a readable telephone number.
hint.format.email: The e-mail address is not complete.
hint.format.postcode: That is not a four-digit postcode.
hint.format.iban: The check digits of the IBAN do not hold.
chat.full: The form has no row left for {n} more entries.
job.unanswered: The recognition did not answer. Your recording is still there.
chat.unanswered: The recognition did not answer. Please say it again or type the answer.
